title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi hủy thẻ được không?
englishTitle: Can you help me cancel my card?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi huy the duoc khong
summary: For asking for help freezing or cancelling a bank card after loss, theft, or a bad charge.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when the card problem needs action now, not a long story first.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the banking app, card photo, receipt, or emergency number if it is safe to do so.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi hủy thẻ được không?
phrases.english: Can you help me cancel my card?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi huy the duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; giúp tôi means help me; hủy thẻ means cancel the card; được không softens the request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi hủy thẻ được không?
breakdown.english: Can you help me cancel my card?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the problem is theft, move to police, report, hotel call, charged twice, or emergency-contact follow-ups.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, bank counters, police desks, shops, or with someone helping you make a call.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Protect private numbers. Show only the screen or contact detail needed for the next action.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use police, report, charged-twice, hotel-call, emergency-contact, or contact-embassy cards if the card problem leads to another step.
